page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn9gc.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance family member built on the KVM hypervisor. Compute capacity is provided by 32 dedicated vCPUs from an AMD EPYC 9A75 processor operating at 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of total system RAM, corresponding to 6.0 GB per vCPU core. Hardware acceleration is delivered by a single NVIDIA Blackwell GPU containing 72 GB of dedicated video memory.

Storage and networking specifications highlight network-dependent operation. The instance provides no integrated local disk storage, requiring external cloud storage volumes for operating system disks and persistent file systems. Network communication is supported by a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile. Public IPv4 connectivity is not included by default and requires assigned elastic network routing.

The dense pairing of 72 GB of GPU VRAM with 32 high-clock dedicated processor cores and 192 GB of host memory positions the configuration for compute and memory-intensive acceleration workloads. These characteristics match requirements for large language model inference, AI model training, computer vision pipelines, and GPU-driven technical simulation tasks.

The system features a 32 Gbps baseline network interface to manage heavy data transfers, while containing no local disk storage, which directs all persistent I/O operations to network-attached storage options. The substantial GPU memory capacity combined with dedicated compute resources positions this instance for AI model inference, deep learning model training, and specialized parallel data processing workloads.
